before.name: Housing cost burden
before.source: CHPC Housing Needs Report; City PIT Count
before.notes: Rents up 24.4% since 2019. 2024 PIT: 1,850 unhoused county-wide (down to 1,473 in 2025). 57% of renters cost-burdened. Highest per-capita homelessness rate in the nation.

after.name: People experiencing homelessness on the PIT count night
after.source: Santa Cruz County Housing for Health Partnership / Applied Survey Research 2026 PITreport
after.notes: The 2026 PIT report, physical page 13, reports one-night counts by jurisdiction. Street enumeration occurred January 29, with shelter occupancy from January 28. The count excludes some forms of homelessness and is not annual persons served. Newly included safe parking/sleeping records added 124 people in Santa Cruz city and 2 in Watsonville compared with prior practice, so annual changes are not directly comparable. The legacy 1,850 was the 2024 COUNTY total, not Santa Cruz city. Housing cost burden remains a separate unresolved measure. No count-based score is inferred from the legacy combined prose target. County: 1,290 unsheltered + 358 sheltered = 1,648.
